_readme: The open position list. Edit this file to change what the site shows —
nothing else needs touching, and the page picks it up on the next load.
One entry per vessel. Keep the quotes and the commas exactly as they are.
dates  "Prompt", or a range such as "09-12 Aug"
pdf    optional. Put the file in assets/fleet/ and name it here,
The order here is the order on the page.
